votes.label: reported
votes.quote: **The bug:** bare times at 12 o'clock come out wrong (`src/parseResetAt.ts`, where the time-only case handles am/pm). The code adds 12 hours for any `pm` time and never handles 12 specially: `12am` returns 12:00 (noon) instead of 00:00 (midnight). `12pm` becomes hour 24, so it rolls over to midnight the next day instead of noon today.
